title: Unhook from a thought
subtitle: Step back and watch a sticky thought, instead of being inside it.

steps.body:
A thought is not a fact, and it is not you.

This is a small practice in stepping back from a sticky thought — watching it pass, instead of being caught inside it.

steps.title: What's the thought that's got you hooked?
steps.body: Write it the way it actually sounds in your head.
steps.placeholder: I'm going to fail. They don't really like me…

steps.body:
Now put this in front of it: 'I'm having the thought that…'

Notice the small space that opens. You are the one noticing the thought — which means you are not the thought itself.
Picture the thought as words on a leaf drifting down a stream, or a cloud crossing the sky. Watch it move, without grabbing it.

steps.title: From a half-step back, what do you notice?
steps.body: Is the thought as solid and true as it felt a minute ago?

exit.body: You didn't argue with the thought or obey it — you watched it. Thoughts come and go; you're the sky they pass through.
